name: Overnight Brown-Butter Waffles
desc: Yeast-raised batter rested overnight for a deep, crisp, almost malty waffle

ingredients.raw: 1 teaspoon (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight)
ingredients.item: (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt (for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight)

ingredients.raw: 10 ounces cold milk; any percentage will do (1 1/4 cups; 280 g)
ingredients.item: cold milk; any percentage will do (1 1/4 cups; 280 g)

ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 teaspoons (4 g) instant dry yeast (not rapid-rise)
Safflower, vegetable, or canola oil for greasing the iron, if needed
10 ounces fresh strawberries (2 cups; 280 g), washed and sliced (optional)
ingredients.item: fresh strawberries (2 cups; 280 g), washed and sliced (optional)

steps: Make the batter: melt the butter in a 3-quart saucepan, stirring and scraping, and cook until golden brown. Remove from heat and stir in the sugar, salt, and milk, then the egg.
Sift in the flour and stir until smooth. Stir in the yeast and baking soda last. Cover and refrigerate overnight, 12 to 18 hours; the batter should be gooey and spongy.
Preheat the waffle iron to medium; brush with oil if needed. For an 8-inch square iron, add half the batter per batch (about one third for a 7-inch Belgian iron).
Close and cook until golden brown but still steaming, 5 to 7 minutes. Hold finished waffles on a rack in a 200°F oven while the rest cook.
Serve with maple syrup, lemon chantilly, and/or strawberries.
